Tipi,9,1 ta ta(ti) [tanu+kvi. Tara+kvi] (1) Thief, Robber. (2) The matter of stealing, Attack, Robbery. See - Takkara-(1). (3) Fox, Wild dog, Jackal. (4) Tails of animals (such as elephant, horse). See - Sūci. (5) Merit, Wholesome deed. See - Takkara-(2). (6) Stomach, Belly. See - Takkoṭaka. (7) Water. (8) Treasure. (A) Treasure such as pearl. (b) Treasure such as Buddha, Law and Sangha.
